newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European fuel oil bunkers steady, Med more active.
newsitem.headline: European fuel oil bunkers steady, Med more active.

text.p: Fuel oil bunker prices in Europe barely changed on Tuesday in a trading session which saw renewed life in the Mediterranean, but little action in northern Europe, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was quoted at around $89 fob, as it was late on Monday, despite a strengthening barge market. Suppliers said the level of demand was slightly higher than on Monday, but not much more than 10,000 tonnes in the whole ARA region.
Hamburg bunkers were similarly unchanged. Demand was also poor.

In the Mediterranean, fuel oil was steady, while gas oil came off in all ports. Suppliers said the temporary stability had persuaded a number of buyers to return to the market to pick up at levels cheaper than last week.
"We'd seen barely any enquiries for a week, but a few turned up today," said one Med supplier.
